title: THE STYLING PASS, STAGE D: THE RUN CARD
why: His order of 2026-10-03: styling across all menus needs massive improvement. Stage D is the run card at the end of every raid: a rounded glass card with a drop shadow, the outcome word glowing in its own colour, the feel tags as pills, and LOG RUN AND RETURN as the one gradient primary button. Nothing moved and no word changed.
now: The end-of-raid card has the new look: glass card, glowing outcome, pill tags and a clear main button.
